sources.entry: Ownfoil - Nintendo Switch library manager, with automated management tasks (file identification and organization, missing updates/DLC), serving your library to multiple supported clients on your Switch, with shop customization and multi user authentication. AGPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Ownfoil is a self-hosted Nintendo Switch library manager that identifies missing updates and DLC, organizes game files, and serves your library as a customizable shop to Switch clients.
summary.what_it_does: Ownfoil manages a Nintendo Switch game library and turns it into a self-hosted shop that Switch clients can browse and install from. It identifies content either by decrypting files or by filename, and reports missing updates or DLC. It can automatically organize, verify, and compress library files and includes console key management. A web interface handles configuration and library browsing, and access is controlled by multi-user authentication. The README says it supports multiple clients and offers shop customization, with full setup details in Install.md and Usage.md.
use_cases: manage a Nintendo Switch game library
find missing Switch updates or DLC
self-host a game shop for Switch
organize and compress Switch game files
serve game files to Switch clients over the network
share a Switch library with multiple user accounts
how_to_run: Follow Install.md for Proxmox LXC setup
Follow Install.md for the Helm chart
Read Usage.md for first steps and the settings reference
notable: Content identification via decryption or filename matching
Automatic library organization, verification and compression
Multi-user authentication with a web interface
Works with multiple Switch clients and supports shop customization
caveats: The README states there is no associated website; only this GitHub repository is official
Not distributed as a packaged application or executable; users must install from the repo's instructions
Setup requires following separate Install.md instructions for each platform
